description:
Connect ChatGPT with Cashfree Payments and manage your entire payments ecosystem through natural conversation. Access merchant dashboard data instantly — including payments, orders, refunds, settlements, payouts, payment links, reconciliation reports, transaction activity, and workflows — without jumping between tools or dashboards.

Built for both operational visibility and developer workflows, the platform is evolving beyond dashboard actions to support the full suite of Cashfree Payments, Payouts, SecureID, PPI, and Partners APIs used in real-world integrations. From tracking live payment flows and debugging transactions to managing settlements and analyzing business performance, ChatGPT becomes your unified AI-powered Cashfree assistant for every payments-related task.

defaultPrompt: Create a Payment Link for Rs 10,000.
Generate a transaction summary report for the last 6 months.
When can I expect my next Settlement, and what will the exact amount be?
